Summary

I am Niriksha G Bangera, a first-year MCA (Master of Computer Applications) student at Poornaprajna Institute of Management, Udupi. I completed my BCA (Bachelor of Computer Applications) at Mangalore University.

I enjoy solving problems and building projects. I have built a Crime Record Management System using PHP and MySQL, and I am now learning Java, Python, C and C++. My dream is to build a career at Google or any software company.

A little introduction

About me

How I approach learning, and the kind of work I enjoy.

Curiosity drives progress

As an MCA student, I am driven by a constant desire to understand how things work under the hood. Whether I am debugging complex algorithms or exploring modern web frameworks, I view every challenge as an opportunity to learn and build better software.

How I like to work

I believe great software starts with clear planning and clean, readable code. I enjoy breaking complex problems into manageable steps, iterating through feedback, and collaborating closely to build reliable, user-friendly applications.
